items.title: Close call at LAX airport as plane turns in front of another aircraft taking off
items.brief: An Air France plane taking off from Los Angeles International Airport made a wrong turn early Saturday morning, putting it in the path of an American Airlines jet, according to the Federal Aviation Administration.

items.title: FBI is investigating a possible killing aboard a cruise ship out of Texas
items.brief: The FBI is investigating a “suspected homicide” aboard a cruise ship that returned to port after departing from Galveston, Texas, the agency said in a statement Monday.

items.title: Ohio State fraternity placed on interim suspension after video shows two people on fire
items.brief: An Ohio State fraternity has been temporarily suspended after a widely circulated video captured two people whose clothes were engulfed in fire, surrounded by a crowd of onlookers in university jerseys.
